text:
Alex K: Heads-up — SkyBridge wants to run a small marketplace connector pilot (hardware + marketplace packaging). Need to align NDA, bench plan, SI handoff, and announcement embargo. Can we triage items?
Maya S: I have the NDA tracker. SkyBridge legal asked for a one-week review window. I can push for redlines today. @Sanjay P can you confirm commercial terms? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sanjay P: I can confirm a draft LOI that matches our standard EAP economic terms. NDA + LOI by Fri sounds doable. Will loop in finance if any deviations.
Tim R: From runtime side we need model/quant profiles + test images. Recommend these minimal bench configs:
```
- model: llama-3-13b-ft
- sequence: 1024
- batch sizes: 1, 4, 16
- perf metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem
```
Also need kernel fallback plan for mixed-precision.
Elena M: For marketplace packaging, we need a connector manifest and a small Helm chart sample. I can draft the manifest template.
Alex K: Good. Can we attach telemetry keys to each bench run so we map to SkyBridge ids? Tim, add agent tags: `partner:skybridge`, `pilot:marketplace-connector`, `run_id`
Tim R: Will do. Example run command we want partners to use:
```bash
run_bench --model llama-3-13b-ft --seq 1024 \ 
  --batch 4 --tags partner:skybridge,pilot:marketplace-connector,run_id:SKY-001
```
partner-bot: NOTE — NDA template v3.4 uploaded to /legal/eaps/NDA_skybridge_v3.pdf (link: https://redwood.internal/legal/NDA_skybridge_v3.pdf)
Maya S: Thanks bot. One ask from SkyBridge: they want preliminary numbers before the formal announcement to validate perf. Can we do a blinded report (no customer logos) by next Tue?
Tim R: We can generate a blinded perf report if they use our run script and tag runs properly. Need 2 repeat runs per config to smooth variance.
Sanjay P: Marketing asked for joint announcement cadence: pre-announce to partner channel, wait 48 hrs, then public blog + marketplace listing. SkyBridge prefers embargo until their epoch window the week after. Propose alignment on embargo date: 2026-04-20.
Elena M: For marketplace listing, we need the following by April 15:
- connector manifest
- sample Helm chart + values.yaml
- packaging checklist (images + digests)
- README with quickstart and pin info
I can own manifest + README.
Alex K: OK owners: NDA/Maya, LOI/Sanjay, runtime bench/Tim, packaging/Elena. Deliverables and rough dates:
- NDA signed: 2026-03-31
- Bench plan + run script posted: 2026-04-05
- First blinded perf report: 2026-04-12
- Marketplace package ready: 2026-04-15
- Embargo/announce target: 2026-04-20
Maya S: I'll ping legal to accelerate. Adding a checklist here: NDA signed, LOI signed, partner lab creds, telemetry keys issued, run script tests green, packaging CI passing.
Tim R: Quick note on acceptance criteria for bench: p95 < 300ms for batch=1 on target SKU, throughput >= baseline (we'll share baseline in bench doc). Failures auto-roll to quantized model variant and note in report.
Sanjay P: I'll draft the partner-facing announcement paragraph and share with SkyBridge comms for sign-off.
Elena M: I'll open a PR for the manifest template and CI today, will tag reviewers.
Alex K: Thanks — can everyone add their calendar availability for a 30m sync tomorrow? If no objections, we'll treat this as the canonical plan and update status in the partnership tracker. :thumbsup:
